data.name: Swept Under
data.detailed_description:
Swept Under is a frantic top-down pixel action-survival where you play the Trash Man, an underpaid worker trapped in a never-ending cafeteria shift. Each wave brings more diners, more mess, and less time. clear every piece of trash before the countdown hits zero or your shift ends.

Trash pays the bills. Spend your earnings at vending machines on better cleaning gear, upgrades, and weapons. Cleaning keeps the cash flowing… but when the workload gets impossible, thinning the crowd means less future trash (and less income). As the cafeteria expands into a chaotic maze of tables, hazards, and choke points, you’ll need the right build and the nerve to stay ahead of the filth. Between runs, unlock permanent upgrades to push further next shift.

data.short_description: Swept Under is a frantic top-down pixel action-survival where you play the Trash Man. Clean every piece of cafeteria garbage before the timer hits zero, earn cash, and buy weapons or tools from vending machines, because sometimes the fastest cleanup is murder.
